title: filenode-server: enforce maxFileNodeDepth
description: From audit JMAP-t8ej.5 (filenode-19 finding brong/draft-gondwana-jmap-filenode#15, PR #16). The server advertises maxFileNodeDepth (crate-jmap-filenode-types/src/capability.rs:42) but never enforces it. Check it in FileNode/set create, the parentId update path (next to the cycle guard, crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/filenode.rs:1159) and FileNode/copy: for a move, depth(new parent) + 1 + height(moved subtree) must stay within the limit. Error: invalidProperties naming parentId (as PR #16 proposes; the draft is silent on the error, so cite filenode-19 maxFileNodeDepth definition and say the error choice follows PR #16). Tests: create at limit ok / limit+1 rejected; move of a subtree that would exceed it rejected; copy likewise.
